D: A bullied boy in 1980s Stockholm befriends a mysterious girl who turns out to be a vampire.
P: Serve the snacks when Oskar and Eli work on the puzzle cube.
S: Beef and pork mince with soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion, allspice and egg, rolled small, browned in butter, finished in a cream and beef stock sauce. Lingonberry jam.
Eli solves Oskar's puzzle cube overnight

A Swedish-style aged cheese tart with a crisp butter pastry, cut into neat cubes and topped with crème fraîche, dill and a little salmon roe. Line a 20cm square tin with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and blind bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs with 250ml cream, 200g grated aged hard cheese (or vintage cheddar), salt and white pepper. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 30 minutes until just set. Cool completely, then cut into 16 cubes. Top each with a dab of crème fraîche, a dill frond and a few pearls of salmon roe.
Rye crispbread with cold butter, shaved hard cheese and thin cucumber

Rye crispbread spread with cold salted butter, shaved aged hard cheese and cucumber sliced paper thin, a grind of white pepper and a few dill fronds on top. Build just before serving so it stays crisp.
M: a Blackeberg winter supper in the flat

Swedish hash of crisp diced potato, smoked ham and onion fried in butter, topped with runny fried eggs, pickled beetroot and parsley. Dice 1kg waxy potatoes into 1cm cubes and parboil 4 minutes, then drain and steam dry. Fry in 40g butter and 2 tbsp oil in a big frying pan for 15 minutes until crisp. Add 2 diced onions and 300g diced smoked ham and cook 8 minutes more. Season well. Fry 4 eggs in butter until the whites set. Serve the hash topped with the eggs, 200g sliced pickled beetroot and chopped parsley.
prawns, dill and mayo on buttered toast
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with mayo, crème fraîche, dill, lemon and a little horseradish, piled on butter-fried bread, roe on top.
W: Soft cardamom dough rolled with cinnamon sugar butter

Cardamom-scented yeasted dough rolled with butter, sugar and cinnamon, cut, knotted, proved, baked at 220C for 10 minutes, pearl sugar on top. Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 75g sugar, 300ml warm milk and 75g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 100g butter, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon. Cut strips, knot and prove 30 minutes. Brush with egg, add pearl sugar and bake at 220C for 10 minutes.
K: Blackcurrant and apple juice simmered with cardamom, cinnamon and orange, no alcohol

Blackcurrant juice warmed with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and orange, served steaming in small glasses with raisins and blanched almonds at the bottom. Put 1L blackcurrant juice, 250ml cloudy apple juice, 1 cinnamon stick, 6 crushed cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 2 strips orange peel and 2 tbsp brown sugar in a saucepan. Heat gently to just below a simmer and hold for 15 minutes. Strain. Put a few raisins and 2 blanched almonds in each of 4 heatproof glasses and pour over the hot glögg.
